scenario.name: CISA AA22-321A, Unit 42 & Sophos — Hunters International Ransomware: Hive Rust Lineage, SharpWMI Lateral Movement & COM IVssBackupComponents Shadow Deletion
scenario.overview: Imagine a successor heist crew that buys the blueprint of an infamous retired vault-cracking machine and upgrades it to run even cleaner and quieter. First, they send remote maintenance orders to wipe backup catalogs; next, instead of loudly shouting the usual shadow-shredder command that wakes every hallway guard, they quietly walk up to the vault backup engine itself and whisper a direct internal delete order; finally, they run a fast multi-lane Rust padlocking press and sweep the empty floor clean so deleted scraps can never be pieced back together. In this scenario (T1047, CISA AA22-321A, Unit 42 & Sophos, Hunters International Ransomware: Hive Rust Lineage, SharpWMI Lateral Movement & COM IVssBackupComponents Shadow Deletion), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: sharpWMI Remote Execution, then direct COM, then multi-Threaded Rust Encryption. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering SharpWMI Remote Execution, then Direct COM, then Multi-Threaded Rust Encryption, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates Sysmon Event 1 with the documented host and network chain.

stages.subtitle: Impact & Defense Evasion (T1490 - Inhibit System Recovery via Native COM API)

To evade SIEM rules that watch for vssadmin.exe delete shadows or wmic.exe shadowcopy delete, the Hunters International Rust binary initializes COM (CoCreateInstance for CLSID_VssBackupComponents in vssapi.dll) and invokes IVssBackupComponents::DeleteSnapshots directly in-process to silently destroy all Volume Shadow Copies (logged in Sysmon Event 7 with EvasionTechnique=In-Process COM IVssBackupComponents::DeleteSnapshots, LoadedModule=C:\Windows\System32\vssapi.dll , Sysmon EventID 7, MitreTechnique=T1490 , Inhibit System Recovery so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact).
